name: Spring River — Cold Springs Boat Ramp to Imboden Boat Ramp
gaugeName: Spring River at Spring Street Bridge at Hardy, AR (USGS 07069305)
blurb: Spring River in Arkansas: sections between public Arkansas Game and Fish Commission accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Cold Springs Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Dam 3: approximate facility area; through passage is not approved. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
sections.accessReview: The public Dam 3 facility area is documented, but a through trip from Cold Springs encounters dam/hatchery structures. A safe, legal passage or carry has not been established; this upstream section remains withheld.

notices.title: Dam 3: upstream passage unresolved
notices.text: Do not plan to paddle through the dam or hatchery grounds. Public facility records do not establish a usable through route or a legal carry from Cold Springs. Check current access conditions with AGFC.
notices.sourceName: Arkansas Game and Fish Commission — Spring River public-access guide

sections.routeReview: The Dam 3 marker is an approximate public facility area. The historical source line crosses hatchery grounds and is not approved for display. No dam passage or exact launch connection is mapped.

notices.title: Dam 3 and Bayou: inspect both accesses
notices.text: Use the signed public Dam 3 launch; the marker is an approximate area beside the hatchery, not an exact water-edge pin. Bayou is listed by AGFC as slide-in only. Inspect both during your shuttle. No dotted route through dam or hatchery structures is shown.
notices.sourceName: Arkansas Game and Fish Commission — public-use facility inventory

putInAccess.sourceName: AGFC Public Use Facilities (AGFC_DATA FeatureServer layer 1), OBJECTID 710
putInAccess.note: AGFC documents the public Dam 3 facility, but its inventory coordinate is inland by the hatchery in the reviewed imagery. Retain the original coordinate as an approximate facility area, not a verified ramp edge. The historical river line through the hatchery grounds is rejected. No dam passage, shore connector or navigation route is approved.
putInAccess.directions: Follow signs for the public Dam 3 access near Jim Hinkle Hatchery. This marker locates the facility area, not the ramp edge. Confirm the public launch on site; do not use hatchery service roads or infer a route through the dam structures.
